newsitem.title: USA: McKesson, Phar-Mor sign new deal.
newsitem.headline: McKesson, Phar-Mor sign new deal.

text.p: McKesson Corp and Phar-Mor Inc Monday agreed to a new five-year contract under which McKesson will supply Phar-Mor's 104 drug stores with pharmaceuticals.
In a statement, McKesson estimated about $250 million in revenue will be generated from the contract in its first year.
This new pact follows a similar arrangement Phar-Mor and FoxMeyer Drug which McKesson assumed in November 1996, and it pays about the same annual rate as the previous agreement.
Based in Youngstown, Ohio, Phar-Mor is a deep discount drug store chain with stores in 20 states.
